segments.text:
I Thanke my God alwayes on your behalfe, for the grace of God, which is geuen you by Ieſus Chriſte, that in all thynges ye are made ryche by hym, in all
vtteraunce, and in all knowledge, by the whiche thynges the teſtimonye of Ieſus Chriſte, was confirmed in you, ſo that ye are behynde in no gyfte, waityng for the apperyng of oure Lorde Ieſus Chriſte, which ſhall alſo ſtrength you vnto the ende, that ye maye be blameles, in the daye of the commyng of oure Lord Ieſus Chriſte.
